collector_notes: Outside-truth pack for P18 (US name). Session WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200) before this task, so nothing below came from a search engine: every value was reached by direct fetch against known URL patterns. PRIMARY source is SEC EDGAR (submissions API, XBRL companyconcept API, and the filed 10-Q/8-K documents themselves) - highest authority available for a US registrant. Aggregator corroboration is stockanalysis.com. Absorbed and replaced the 200-byte legacy stub at packs/ONC.json (status 'in-progress', no data). SESSION-2 CONTINUATION: this file already had the full identity/price/valuation/results block from a prior pass, marked in-progress with empty traps/world_gaps/sources arrays and null isin/listing_date. This pass, per PROMPT_data_s2.md's continue-from-existing rule, kept every existing field verbatim and only filled what was missing: isin (SEC EDGAR has none; found via stockanalysis.com/company/), listing_date (Wikipedia), corporate_actions_2026, last_3_announcements, traps, world_gaps, sources_actually_read/attempted_and_failed, and flipped status to complete-with-recorded-gaps. NOTE ON THE MANIFEST'S OWN reference BLOCK: manifest.json for P18 records revenue_usd_h1_2026 = '1.71bn' - that figure is Q2 2026 REVENUE ALONE ($1,705,071,000), not H1. Filed H1 2026 revenue is $3,218,509,000. Its revenue_growth_yoy_pct = 30 is the Q2-2026 YoY (+29.6%), not the FY2025 YoY (+40.2%) nor the H1 YoY (+32.3%). Recorded here so the differ does not inherit the manifest's error as truth.

legal_name.basis: Exact registrant name on the cover of the Q2 2026 Form 10-Q, and the EDGAR conformed name returned by https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001651308.json ('name': 'BeOne Medicines Ltd.').
legal_name.disagreement: stockanalysis.com renders the company as 'BeOne Medicines AG' (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/onc/, as_of 2026-09-18). BOTH are defensible: Swiss corporate law lets an Aktiengesellschaft register and use 'Ltd.' as an equivalent suffix, and the registrant itself signs SEC filings 'BEONE MEDICINES LTD.'. This matters for P18 specifically - see traps.ltd_vs_ag_is_not_staleness.

pe_ttm.basis: Price per ADS 350.84 / EPS per ADS 5.59. Both sides are in ADS units; a pipeline that divides the ADS price by the FILED per-ordinary-share EPS (USD 0.43 TTM) gets a PE of 816x.

roe.basis: Reproduced exactly from filed data: TTM net income 655,707,000 / average of shareholders' equity at 2025-06-30 (3,770,475,000) and 2026-06-30 (5,173,998,000) = 655,707 / 4,472,237 = 14.66%.

alternative_bases.basis: TTM net income / ENDING equity (5,173,998,000). Equity grew 37% in twelve months, so ending-balance ROE understates by ~2 points.
TTM net income / average of FY2025-end equity (4,361,194,000) and 2026-06-30 equity.

roce.basis: DERIVED, not sourced: TTM EBIT (operating income) 923,098,000 / capital employed (total assets 9,175,615,000 - current liabilities 2,119,187,000 = 7,056,428,000). Ending-balance basis.

disagreement.note: 2.6x the ROCE above, and the gap is PURE DENOMINATOR DEFINITION, not a data conflict: the company holds USD 5.10bn cash against USD 2.05bn total debt, so a cash-netted invested-capital base (debt + equity - cash = ~2.1bn) is a third the size of a capital-employed base (~7.1bn). Any screen that treats 'ROCE' and 'ROIC' as interchangeable will rank this name wildly differently depending on which one it picked.

debt_to_equity.basis: DERIVED from filed XBRL: (LongTermDebtNoncurrent 882,163,000 + LongTermDebtCurrent 190,896,000) / StockholdersEquity 5,173,998,000.

disagreement.note: NEARLY DOUBLE the filed-debt ratio. stockanalysis prints 'Total Debt: 2.05B' against filed interest-bearing debt of 1.073bn; the ~0.98bn difference is consistent with capitalised operating + finance lease liabilities being folded into 'debt'. Both numbers are defensible; neither is wrong; a differ MUST carry the definition or it will report a false 93% error.

revenue_ttm.basis: DERIVED by summing filed quarters Q3 2025 + Q4 2025 + Q1 2026 + Q2 2026 = 1,412,284 + 1,498,170 + 1,513,438 + 1,705,071 (thousands). Q4 2025 is itself derived as FY2025 5,343,033 minus 9M 2025 3,844,863 - the company files no standalone Q4.

traps.description: Every quoted headline number (price, EPS, book value per share) is per-ADS; 1 ADS = 13 ordinary shares. The company's XBRL reports EPS/shares per ORDINARY share. Dividing the ADS price by the filed per-ordinary-share EPS understates PE by 13x (correct ~63x vs wrongly-computed ~816x).

The registrant signs its own SEC filings 'BeOne Medicines Ltd.' though it is Swiss-incorporated; aggregators render it 'BeOne Medicines AG'. 'Correcting' Ltd. to AG (or vice versa) overrides a legally correct, currently-filed name - it is not a staleness bug.

EDGAR's ticker list for this CIK still carries BEIGF (OTC) alongside ONC, 8+ months after the BGNE->ONC change. A 'one company = one ticker' pipeline will either drop a live OTC line or wrongly flag BEIGF as delisted.

Every 10-Q/10-K/8-K primary-document filename still starts with 'bgne-' (e.g. bgne-20260630.htm filed 2026-08-05) though the ticker has been ONC since Jan 2025. A URL-pattern scraper keyed on the current ticker string will not find these filings.

The fetched ISIN (US07725L1026) is the Nasdaq ADS ISIN only. The HKEX (06160) and STAR Market (688235) lines carry separate ISINs not fetched here. Storing one ISIN per company (not per listing) silently discards two of the three securities.

The name-change announcement (two 8-Ks, 2024-11-14) and EDGAR's registrant-record flip to 'BeOne Medicines Ltd.' (2025-05-27) are six months apart, and the Switzerland redomicile is also dated May 2025 - three distinct identity events (name announced Nov 2024; ticker changed Jan 2025; name+domicile effective May 2025) a pipeline must not conflate into one date.

us-gaap:Revenues is EMPTY for every 2025+ period for this filer; revenue lives under us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax. A fetcher hard-coded to the generic 'Revenues' tag returns nothing for a USD 5.3bn-revenue company, and a null-to-zero renderer shows it as zero-revenue.

On 2026-09-18 there are four correct 'revenue growth YoY' figures depending on period (Q2: 29.6%, H1: 32.3%, TTM: 34.3%, FY2025: 40.2%). The manifest's own reference block for this slot records 30% with no period label - the seed data already exhibits the trap it is testing for.
